name: hex-local
title: Hex
description: Search dictation history and control Hex on this Mac
author: alvarogar4

preferences.name: hexPath
preferences.title: Hex CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the Hex command-line executable

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: Search History
commands.description: Find a dictation and copy its final text to the clipboard

preferences.name: allowTranscriptTrash
preferences.label: Allow moving transcripts to Trash
preferences.description: Show the Move Transcript to Trash action on selected dictations

commands.name: stop-dictation
commands.title: Stop Dictation
commands.description: Finish the current dictation and transcribe it

commands.name: toggle-dictation
commands.title: Toggle Dictation
commands.description: Start dictation when idle or finish the current dictation

commands.name: cancel-dictation
commands.title: Cancel Dictation
commands.description: Discard the current dictation after confirmation

commands.name: paste-last
commands.title: Paste Last
commands.description: Paste the last dictation at the current focus

commands.name: switch-model
commands.title: Switch Model
commands.description: Choose an installed transcription model or download another

commands.name: language
commands.title: Language
commands.description: Change the transcription language for the selected model

commands.name: vocabulary
commands.title: Vocabulary
commands.description: Manage terms and their sounds-like spellings

commands.name: microphone
commands.title: Microphone
commands.description: Choose a microphone by name and change microphone behavior

commands.name: status
commands.title: Status
commands.description: Check recording, model, queued jobs, and meeting status

commands.name: meetings
commands.title: Meetings
commands.description: Find recorded meetings and control meeting recording

commands.name: start-meeting
commands.title: Start Meeting Recording
commands.description: Record a meeting with an optional title

commands.name: stop-meeting
commands.title: Stop Meeting & Transcribe
commands.description: Stop recording the current meeting and transcribe it

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Settings
commands.description: Browse Hex settings and edit writable values

scripts.lint: eslint src tests && prettier --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs README.md
